notes_for_editor: Only the register gives tower details, and it gives no exact build year, so no built event is recorded. Record status 'standing' is not confirmed: the register's NHLR page we read has no status field and no source says the tower stands today. Height 80 ft converted to 24.4 m. The OFS history gives context on 1930s CCC fire towers but does not name Bear Mountain. The Forest Lookouts page has only a county line. Access and condition left out. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 3 page reads (NHLR, Forest Lookouts, OFS history) plus one FFLA Oklahoma list that returned no Bear Mountain row.
